title: Self-Driving and Self-Parking Features
summary: Feedback centers on self-driving and self-parking functions, with a few clearly positive comments, one clear complaint about highway assistant usefulness and attentiveness demands, and many fragments that mention the features without enough clarity for firm sentiment assignment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the self-driving or driver-assistance functions as appreciated and satisfying to use.

negative.summary: Negative feedback questions the usefulness of the self-driving function because it requires constant attention and issues warnings or disengages.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention self-driving or self-parking as helpful, cool, confusing, below par, or simply not yet used, but the sample does not provide enough consistent context for firm sentiment labeling.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing detailed sentiment patterns.
The topic mixes self-driving, highway assistant, and self-parking comments, so the examples do not form a fully coherent single feature narrative.
Several undetermined fragments contain opinion-like wording, but the provided labels prevent treating them as explicit positive or negative evidence.
